name: Armenian Genocide Museum-Institute
terms_summary: No terms of use or photo-reuse policy is published; the only notice is a generic footer copyright line ('2007-2021 © The Armenian Genocide Museum-Institute'). Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default; many pre-1923 photos may be public domain, but AGMI gives no rights statements.
notes: Plain PHP site in four languages (Eng/Հայ/Türk/Рус); robots.txt is empty. No API. Its USC Shoah Foundation VHA testimonies are licensed third-party content.

name: Pan-Armenian Digital Library (ARAR)
count_note: Homepage counter: 'contains 327 032 digital objects' (2026-11-02). OAI-PMH ListIdentifiers (oai_dc) reports completeListSize=309,205 on the same date. Mostly Armenian-language or Armenia-related, but includes NAS RA science publications.
terms_summary: No terms of use or licence page exists (the dLibra 'polityka' page is undefined). The OAI records carry no dc:rights, and the Rights/License/Access-rights fields shown on item pages are empty. Some items are restricted to privileged accounts. The 'About' page states an open-science mission only, so Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default.
notes: dLibra 6.2.12 (PSNC Poznań). OAI formats: oai_dc, oai_qdc, mets, dlibra_avs, oai_etdms. Sets include books1, Articles, periodicals1, Mekhitaristcongregation(+books), armenian_and_armenogram_turkish_publications, institute_of_arts, pubios, IGS, InstLit, IAE, digital (repatriation), Audio, Maps, Posters, exhibition. robots.txt disallows /Content/*/download*, zip and search-result pages, so harvest metadata over OAI and avoid bulk file download. No IIIF manifest found. Hosts digitized Etchmiadzin journal (publication 369886) and IAE publications (set IAE, 580 records).

name: Scientific Research Center of Historical and Cultural Heritage
terms_summary: No terms or copyright statement is published; the footer only credits the web developer. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default. robots.txt blocks only /wp-admin/.
notes: WordPress (wp-sitemap.xml available). An English version exists at /en/home/. Useful for monument descriptions, but there is no structured register here; the legal register is the Government-approved state lists (see am.monuments-state-list).

name: American University of Armenia Library – Digital Collections
terms_summary: No library-wide reuse terms found. Repository items follow their own author licences. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default.
notes: library.aua.am is WordPress with Yoast and an empty Disallow in robots.txt. The catalogue is WorldCat Discovery (aualibrary.on.worldcat.org). AUA LibGuides link the Public Radio archive (armradioarchive.am). Treat DIGILIB as the primary AUA heritage source; this entry is an umbrella.

name: Yeghishe Charents Museum of Literature and Arts (GAT Museum)
name_local: Եղիշե Չարենցի անվան գրականության և արվեստի թանգարան
terms_summary: No terms of use are published; the only notice is a footer '© 2026 GAT Museum'. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default. Open Jerusalem descriptions of GAT fonds state that access needs the museum's authorization.
notes: Joomla site (RSS/Atom feeds via ?format=feed). The 'ՇՏԵՄԱՐԱՆ' (databases) menu has three databases: processed fonds (articles announcing processed personal archives), published books, and photographs. Some fonds are described in the Open Jerusalem archives (AM-GAT/...), e.g. Tekeyan, Chopanyan, Oshakan.

name: National Cinema Center of Armenia
terms_summary: No terms could be read: ncca.am resolves but timed out on 2026-11-02. Hayfilm/Armenfilm productions are copyrighted works; Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default.
notes: SNCO under the culture ministry, created in 2006 from the Hayfilm studio. Most film elements are held by the National Archives' National Film Library (Cine-Photo Documentation branch); access there needs special permission. Restoration work with Prasad Corp aims at screening and online access, but no public catalogue was found.

name: Digital Library of Armenian Literature (DIGILIB)
count_note: Site 'About' page: 2,000 works by 625 authors (read 2026-11-02).
terms_summary: No terms of use or copyright statement is published. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default. Classical texts (5th–18th c.) are public domain, but 20th-century Western Armenian authors may still be in copyright, and the digital editions carry no licence.
notes: Same site at digilib.aua.am. The bare domain digilib.am timed out; use www.digilib.am. robots.txt disallows only /111/ and /222/. Browse by theme or author; there is a login for 'My Projects'. No API.

name: Eastern Armenian National Corpus (EANC)
count_note: 9,960 documents, ~110 million tokens (written ~106M, oral ~3.5M), per Khurshudyan et al., DigitAm 2022 (ACL Anthology).
terms_summary: The corpus is described as open access for search at www.eanc.net. No licence or bulk download was found; full texts (modern fiction and press) are copyrighted and served only as search hits.
notes: eanc.net resolves (83.149.210.101) but timed out on 2026-11-02. The project began in 2006 and went online in 2007. Developers include V. Khurshudyan (INALCO), T. Arkhangelskiy (Hamburg), M. Daniel and A. Polyakov (HSE), and V. Plungian (RAS). It has morphological and semantic annotation plus English glosses. It is a linguistic resource, not heritage records, and low priority for aggregation.

name: Erebuni Historical and Archaeological Museum-Reserve
terms_summary: No terms or collection data are published; the only web presence is a directory page on mus.am. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default.
notes: mus.am is a directory of cultural places (ICOM Armenia link), not a collection database. Some Erebuni objects (Urartian inscriptions) may appear in CDLI or Wikidata. Low priority: no digital collection.

name: Mother See of Holy Etchmiadzin – Vache and Tamar Manoukian Matenadaran (Library)
name_local: Մայր Աթոռ Սուրբ Էջմիածնի «Վաչե և Թամար Մանուկյան» մատենադարան
terms_summary: No digital reuse terms; the footer says 'all rights reserved'. The 'Library law and rules' page lists the Law on Libraries, the library's user rules and Government decisions on library collections (including a 2013 procedure for the Armenian-script digital library); none of these grant reuse rights. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default.
notes: The main site is a custom Yii-based CMS (built by fractal.am); robots.txt blocks only backend directories. The catalogue is a separate Koha OPAC at koha.etchmiadzinlibrary.am; its OAI-PMH reports 'OAI-PMH service is disabled'. The library links to the ArmUniCat union catalogue (armunicat.nla.am). Other site databases: encyclicals, Bible, Armenian Church directory.

name: History Museum of Armenia
count_note: 599 records in wp-sitemap-posts-collections_type-1.xml (online collection; about 50 pages × 12), 2026-11-02. The museum holds about 400,000 objects in total (homepage).
terms_summary: Photos on the site are protected under Armenian copyright law. Reproducing, distributing, adapting or otherwise reusing them is prohibited without the museum's prior permission. Site copyright is reserved (the footer year is an unfilled placeholder).
notes: WordPress; the REST API is closed to anonymous users ('Only authenticated users can access the REST API'). robots.txt blocks only /wp-admin/; records are reachable via the sitemap and taxonomy filters (collection_filter, period_filter, location_filter, material_filter). Records are Armenian-language only.

name: Institute of Archaeology and Ethnography, National Academy of Sciences of the Republic of Armenia
name_local: ՀՀ ԳԱԱ Հնագիտության և ազգագրության ինստիտուտ
count_note: 580 records in ARAR OAI set dLibraDigitalLibrary:IAE (institute publications), 2026-11-02. The institute library holds 44,500+ units (catalogued in Koha; no public OPAC link found).
terms_summary: No terms are published; the 'Terms & conditions' and 'Privacy policy' footer links are empty placeholders ('#'). Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default.
notes: The site footer shows a leftover template notice '© Սարյան ընտանիք' (Saryan family), not a real rights claim. robots.txt has an empty Disallow. The site includes a '100 archaeological monuments of Armenia' section. Excavation archives and the folklore archive are not online.

name: Komitas Museum-Institute
terms_summary: No terms of use are published; the footer says only '©2026 Komitas Museum-Institute'. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default. Komitas (d. 1935) is out of copyright as an author, but the museum's scans and texts carry no licence.
notes: robots.txt allows / but disallows /api/ (the site is a JS front end with an internal API). Sections: biography, photos, recordings, Komitas's articles, letters, archival collection, music library, publications.

name: Matenadaran – Mesrop Mashtots Research Institute of Ancient Manuscripts
name_local: Մեսրոպ Մաշտոցի անվան հին ձեռագրերի գիտահետազոտական ինստիտուտ – Մատենադարան
count_note: Armenian holdings: 11,230 basic manuscripts + 2,200 fragments + 530 scrolls (Mayr Tsutsak page, matenadaran.am, read 2026-11-02). The repository page gives ~23,000 manuscripts, fragments and amulets in all languages. None of these are browsable as item-level records online.
terms_summary: No reuse or licensing terms are published. Digital copies of manuscripts are supplied for a fee under a price list (linked). Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default; the medieval texts are public domain, but image reuse needs the institute's permission. robots.txt blocks only /wp-admin/.
notes: WordPress; the public wp-json REST API works (posts/pages search) and wp-sitemap.xml is available. The 'Digital repositories' menu lists: Digital library (publication PDFs under /ftp/el_gradaran/), Mayr Tsutsak PDFs (/ftp/data/M/Hator-N.pdf), Catholicosal Diwan catalogue, Matenagirk Hayots (medieval texts), early printed books, maps, Banber Matenadarani (banber.matenadaran.am) and MEMAS (journalmatenadaran.com). No IIIF or image viewer. Manuscript records overlap with the Index of Armenian Manuscripts and the Mayr Tsutsak PDFs.

name: State Lists of Immovable Historical and Cultural Monuments of the Republic of Armenia
name_local: Պատմության և մշակույթի անշարժ հուշարձանների պետական ցուցակ
count_note: 24,221 immovable monuments on the state lists per 2019 data reported in the press (hyetert.org, 19 Sep 2020; other reports date the figure to 2021). This counts list entries, not digital records.
terms_summary: The lists are Government decisions, which are legal acts. Article 4 of the Law on Copyright and Related Rights excludes official documents (legal acts, treaties and their official translations) from copyright, so the list texts are free to reuse. ARLIS publishes no separate site terms.
notes: Legal basis: Law on the Protection and Use of Immovable Monuments of History and Culture and of Historical Environment (1998). Entries carry state index codes (պետցուցիչ, e.g. 3.82.1). The lists exist only as tables inside decision texts on ARLIS; the new ARLIS uses URLs like /hy/acts/{id}/latest, and amendments must be merged. No official machine-readable dataset was found; escs.am returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) to scripts. Overlaps: Wiki Loves Monuments Armenia lists and Wikidata use these codes.

name: Electronic Information Database of Cultural Values ('Armenian Treasury')
count_note: About 156,586 cultural values entered and approved, from 41 state and community organisations (Compendium of Cultural Policies, Armenia profile 2.4; figure from ~2020, when the first stage ended).
terms_summary: No terms could be found. The live site could not be inspected; treasury.am returns a Cloudflare challenge, and it is not confirmed that this domain hosts the database. Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default.
notes: Do not confuse with mus.am (an ICOM Armenia directory of museums and cultural places) or museumsarmenia.am (the unified e-ticketing system, 2024). armeniantreasury.am does not resolve. Coverage is state museums, archives, and manuscript and printed holdings; private collections only with owner consent. Needs a human check or contact with the Ministry of ESCS.

name: National Archives of Armenia
terms_summary: No online terms could be read (site unreachable). Per EHRI, reading-room access requires an official letter from the researcher's institution addressed to the Director General. Archival documents fall under the Law on Archives and copyright law defaults.
notes: Services reported: reading hall, online exhibitions, e-requests, genealogy service. The film archive (National Film Library / Cine-Photo Documentation branch) is part of the National Archives and holds most Hayfilm output. Retry armarchive.am from an Armenian network or by hand.

name: National Gallery of Armenia
terms_summary: Terms could not be read: gallery.am serves a Radware 'Verifying your browser' challenge to scripts and WebFetch, although robots.txt says 'Allow: /'. With no published licence, Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default; artworks by 20th-century Armenian artists are largely in copyright.
notes: Branches have their own pages (e.g. Gavar, Martuni). Holdings mix Armenian, Russian and Western European art. Needs a manual browser check for the online collection and image terms.

name: National Library of Armenia
count_note: 13,244 items in the NLA DSpace digital repository (api.nla.am discover/search, dsoType=ITEM), queried 2026-11-02. Excludes the separate Armenian Book (haygirk.nla.am) and Armenian Press (tert.nla.am) databases, whose sizes could not be read (Cloudflare).
terms_summary: The Armenian Book database states that its materials may be used for personal, academic and informational purposes, with a mandatory reference to the NLA databases; commercial use is not granted. No licence is published for the DSpace repository (items carry no dc.rights), so Armenian Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2006) applies by default; theses and recent NLA publications are in copyright.
notes: Digital Repository runs DSpace 9.2 (not 7); REST API at https://api.nla.am/server/api is open and unauthenticated. One top community ('Digital Repository of NLA') with 6 sub-communities: Theses & Abstracts; Endangered Heritage of Artsakh; NLA Publications; Armenica; International mass media about Artsakh; Non-Book Publications. The DSpace OAI endpoint https://api.nla.am/server/oai/request returns HTTP 500 (2026-11-02). The UI (dspace.nla.am), nla.am, haygirk and tert are behind a Cloudflare managed challenge, so harvest through the REST API only. Platform of haygirk/tert unknown. Related: union catalogue armunicat.nla.am, journal.nla.am (OJS).

name: Sergei Parajanov Museum
count_note: Main collection of 1,766 exhibits (About Museum page, 2026-11-02). The online Gallery shows a selection grouped by period.
terms_summary: Site texts and images are the museum's property and are protected under Armenian copyright law. Use is limited to personal, informational and educational purposes. Electronic reproduction and commercial or other distribution are prohibited without permission.
notes: robots.txt has an empty Disallow, and a sitemap is available. Parajanov's works (he died in 1990) are in copyright until 2060 under the life+70 term. Built by Concept Studio; sponsored by JTI Armenia.

name: Public Radio of Armenia – Armenian Radio Archive
name_local: Հայաստանի հանրային ռադիո – Հանրային ռադիոյի արխիվ
count_note: 11,371 item URLs in sitemap/items-1.xml (10,000) and items-2.xml (1,371), lastmod Oct 2026, read 2026-11-02. The About page says the archive preserves ~100,000 recordings; not all are online.
terms_summary: The footer states '© 2026 Armenian Radio Archive. All rights reserved'; no licence or reuse terms are published. Recordings are streamed for listening only. Performers' and producers' rights apply under Armenian law.
notes: Streaming platform for the 'Golden Fund' (digitized with the culture ministry since 2009). Browse by genre, decade, artist and chronology; there is a mobile app. robots.txt is 'Allow: /' with sitemaps in hy/en/ru (items, makers). Built by Digital Pomegranate, funded in honour of Hambardzum and Mary Ingilizian. The main broadcaster site is armradio.am.

name: Research on Armenian Architecture (RAA) Foundation
count_note: 699,250 digitized images in the RAA database by end of 2024 (RAA USA site); 6,132 documented monuments. The RAA Armenia homepage shows an older 625,000. The database is internal, not online.
terms_summary: The footer states '© 2021 ՀՃՈՒ. All rights reserved'; no reuse licence is offered. The photo archive is not public and needs a direct request to RAA.
notes: raa.am does not respond; the official site is raa-am.org (WordPress, robots.txt Crawl-Delay: 20). It offers a gallery, 3D models, publications and restoration news. The RAA's 2025 report mentions a redesign of its internal photo database. Strong coverage of Western Armenia, Artsakh and Nakhichevan monuments; high-value partner, but needs an agreement.

name: Centre for Armenian Studies, National University of Rosario (Cátedra Armenia)
name_local: Centro de Estudios Armenios – Cátedra Armenia, Universidad Nacional de Rosario
terms_summary: No terms, copyright notice or licence was found. The site is a client-side app with no server-rendered content.
notes: React/Vite single-page app: index.html is an empty shell, and the JS bundle holds no content, which is probably loaded at runtime. For UNR Armenian-studies output, harvest RepHip (https://rephip.unr.edu.ar/server/api, DSpace 7) by query or collection instead. Low priority.

name: Diario Armenia
count_note: WordPress REST /wp-json/wp/v2/posts X-WP-Total = 12,698 on 2026-11-02. The oldest online post is dated 2014-10-24. No digitized back-issue archive (1931–2014) was found online; print records reportedly sit with the Daghlian Library, Buenos Aires (ANCA news).
terms_summary: The two statements conflict. The site footer allows reproduction if the source is named with a link. The terms page (written for the mobile app) reserves all IP and bars copying or distribution without prior written consent. Bots are not addressed, and robots.txt blocks only /wp-admin/. Link-back citation is the minimum; get written consent for bulk or commercial reuse.
notes: WordPress (theme 'Armenia2020', by Fenix Design). REST API and RSS (/rss) are open, but bare curl gets 403: send a browser User-Agent. Content is contemporary news, so it is useful for community events, not heritage objects. Consider metadata-only links.

name: Mekhitarist Congregation Vienna (Mechitharisten) - Library and Periodicals Portal
count_note: OAI-PMH completeListSize on arar.sci.am (2026-11-02): set Mekhitaristcongregation (Periodicals Portal) 105,568; Mekhitaristcongregationbooks 730; armenian_and_armenogram_turkish_publications (manuscripts) 86. Records are mostly per periodical issue.
terms_summary: mechitaristlibrary.org has a Copyright page, but it is a JavaScript app and its text could not be read; the footer shows only a copyright notice for the library. Sample oai_dc records carry no dc:rights. 2022 announcements say the material is freely accessible; no licence was found.
notes: arar.sci.am robots.txt disallows /dlibra/results, search, download and zip paths but not OAI-PMH, so harvest via OAI. Congregation site: https://www.mechitharisten.org/. mekhitar.univie.ac.at (Armeno-Turkish project) was down for maintenance on 2026-11-02. Overlaps the Armenian national/academy digital library sources.

name: Trove
terms_summary: API v3 requires a personal key under the Trove API Terms of Use; non-commercial keys are free, while commercial use needs explicit permission from the National Library of Australia. Since 2025 the NLA treats harvesting resource content (e.g. full text of digitised newspaper and journal articles) through the API, beyond descriptive metadata, as a breach unless an exemption agreement is negotiated; some researchers' keys were reportedly cancelled. A 5,000 requests/day figure circulates only in unofficial sources.
notes: Metadata-only integration is the safe path: store Trove work/article ids and link out. robots.txt disallows /api/search/* and several paths for crawlers. GLAM Workbench Trove tools (Tim Sherratt) were archived after key cancellation, so third-party harvesters may no longer work.

name: Zoryan Institute
count_note: Armenian Genocide Oral History Collection: AUA library lists 780 interviews (Armenian 77%, English 22%, Turkish 1%); Zoryan cites 750+ interviews and ~3,000 hours. The downloadable catalogue (xlsx, 21 alphabetical sheets) has ~1,200 populated rows in the downloaded catalogue; rows may not equal interviews. Also Syrian-Armenian and 44-Day War oral history collections.
terms_summary: Recordings may be viewed only on site, by appointment, for research or education; they cannot be borrowed and general requesters get no copies. Direct descendants can buy a copy (US/CAD $450 per oral history). Publishing any part needs a signed Copyright Agreement with the Institute.
notes: Recordings are consulted at the Zoryan Institute & AUA Center for Oral History (AGBU Papazian Library, American University of Armenia, Yerevan): https://library.aua.am/ziauaoh/collections-armgen/. The catalogue xlsx (881 KB) has columns #, Last/First/Maiden Name, parents' names, Gender, Interview Date, Birth Year/Place/Region, Interview Length, Language, notes. It holds personal data on survivors; consider privacy before republishing. WordPress site.

name: Bayerische Staatsbibliothek - Digitale Sammlungen / MDZ (Cod.armen.)
count_note: bavarikon: BSB holds 30 Armenian manuscripts (Cod.armen.); undated page. IArM v3.0 lists 5 digitised (e.g. Cod.armen. 1 = bsb00070502, Cod.armen. 6). Web search UI is JS-only, so no exact digitised count.
terms_summary: Each object carries a rights statement. Cod.armen. manifests use Public Domain Mark 1.0, which per the MDZ FAQ allows copying, modification and commercial use without permission. Other categories (in copyright, Google scans non-commercial) differ. The FAQ states no metadata licence.
notes: IIIF Presentation v2/v3 and Image v3 APIs at api.digitale-sammlungen.de; METS/MODS via api.digitale-sammlungen.de/dfg/mets/mods/v1/digitalobjects/identifier/{bsbid}. robots.txt allows all. Older daten.digitale-sammlungen.de/~db/... permalinks (used in IArM) are legacy. IArM also links BSB-hosted images of Matenadaran M6200. BSB also has Armenian printed books and audio (Europeana).

name: German Digital Library
count_note: DDB Solr search endpoint /2/search/index/search/select, 2026-11-02: q='armenisch OR armenien OR armenier OR armenian' = 8,461; q='armenisch' = 4,927; fq=language_fct:arm (Armenian-language objects) = 2,748.
terms_summary: All metadata delivered by the DDB API is CC0; digital objects (images, media) keep the rights statement of each provider (license field per record). The terms require an API key obtained in a 'My DDB' account and ask that applications show a 'Powered by Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek' label; DDB reserves the right to limit request volume (no number published). Observed: the /2/search/index Solr endpoint answered without a key, while the classic /search endpoint returned 403 without one.
notes: language_fct:arm is a reliable Armenian-language filter; combine with keyword query for subject matter. Fields include license, metadata_rights, provider, place_fct. DDB is Germany's aggregator to Europeana (overlap), and includes the Deutsches Zeitungsportal newspapers. Obtain a key before production use, since keyless access may be withdrawn.

name: Houshamadyan – Open Digital Archive (ODA)
terms_summary: Houshamadyan e.V. reserves all rights to the site's texts, design, photos, audio and video, with a 2011 notice. Only personal, non-commercial use is allowed. Any other copying, publishing or adaptation needs prior written permission, though linking is allowed. No separate ODA licence exists, so the site-wide terms cover ODA images.
notes: TYPO3 CMS with static HTML pages at /oda/<region>/<collection>.html. Collection pages are image galleries with captions, and there is no API, OAI or IIIF. robots.txt does not exist (it returns the TYPO3 404 page). Images sit under fileadmin/. Item metadata would have to be scraped from captions, and the copyright terms forbid reuse without permission.

name: Lepsiushaus Potsdam
terms_summary: German copyright applies. Copying, editing or distributing beyond legal limits needs the author's written consent, and downloads are for private, non-commercial use only. The archive can be visited by appointment, and single sources can be supplied digitally on request by NC number.
notes: Webflow site (cdn.prod.website-files.com) with a cookie consent banner. No catalogue, API or digital edition online. Use as a collection-level reference record only. Candidate for a cooperation request, e.g. digitized Lepsius journals.

name: Real Biblioteca del Monasterio de San Lorenzo de El Escorial - Real Biblioteca Digital
name_local: Real Biblioteca del Monasterio de San Lorenzo de El Escorial (Patrimonio Nacional)
count_note: Omeka S API search, 2026-11-02: 'armenio' gives 3 hits, 'armen' gives 17, 'Armenian' and 'armenia' give 0. None are Armenian-language mss; hits are Greek and Latin codices. Total items 1,518.
terms_summary: No licence on items or IIIF manifests (no rights or license fields). The Patrimonio Nacional legal notice is a generic IP and website notice (bans framing) with no open licence for images or metadata.
notes: No Armenian-language manuscripts found in the Real Biblioteca Digital; the 'Ephraem Syrus' manuscript cited in v1 (Psi-II-9) is Greek. Kept only to document the correction. Omeka S REST API is public: /api/items?search=..., IIIF v2 manifests at rbdigital.realbiblioteca.es/files/manifests/{shelfmark}.json.

name: Hispana
name_local: Hispana – Directorio nacional de recursos digitales
terms_summary: The Aviso Legal covers general portal use by the Ministerio de Cultura and does not set an explicit licence for harvested metadata; Hispana only links to objects held by contributing institutions, whose own rights statements apply. Hispana says it acts as both OAI-PMH harvester and OAI-PMH repository, but no public base URL was found (/oai/OAIHandler returned 404).
notes: Hispana is Spain's national aggregator to Europeana, so the practical route is Europeana's API (filter by provider 'Hispana') rather than the Hispana portal. Records link out to holding institutions (university repositories, regional digital libraries such as BVPB).

name: Europeana
count_note: Europeana Search API (wskey=api2demo), 2026-11-02: multilingual OR query (armenia, armenian, armenien, arménien, armeno, armenio, armeens, армянский, Հայաստան) = 18,393; query 'armenian' = 7,582; 'where:Armenia' = 12,295; 'where:(Armenia OR Hayastan OR Arménie OR Armenien)' = 12,740; qf=LANGUAGE:hy = 0. Language facet of 'armenian' results: en 5,197, mul 663, de 545, fr 317, hu 238.
terms_summary: All Europeana metadata is CC0; each digital object carries its own rights statement in edm:rights (for the 7,582 'armenian' hits: CC0 4,381, CC BY 984, InC 492, CC BY-NC 320, CC BY-SA 305, NoC-NC 265, NoC-OKLR 221, PDM 172). Search/Record APIs need a free API key that is personal to one application and must not be shared (api2demo is for testing only); the API FAQ says there is no throttling but asks for a short pause between calls, and the terms let Europeana impose reasonable limits. IIIF and SPARQL work without a key.
notes: Best recall: multilingual OR keyword query plus where:(...) place query, then dedupe by record id. LANGUAGE:hy facet is empty, so do not rely on the language facet. Bulk: per-dataset EDM XML zips at https://download.europeana.eu/dataset/XML/ (open directory, verified); OAI-PMH at https://api.europeana.eu/oai (Identify verified). Overlaps: DDB, Hispana, Gallica partner content, Institut de France (Mazarine), Polona/FBC, Wellcome; dedupe against national aggregators.

name: AGBU Nubar Library
terms_summary: The site footer reads '© 2016 La Bibliothèque Nubar de l'UGAB – Paris – Tous droits réservés'. No reuse licence or terms page exists, so reuse needs the library's permission. robots.txt blocks only the Joomla system folders.
notes: Joomla site, HTTP only, with FR/EN pages under /index.php/fr|en/. It is static article pages with image galleries: no catalogue, API or IIIF. Calfa (calfa.fr/blog/7) has a scientific partnership with the library on Armenian OCR/HTR, which could feed future full-text output. Good candidate for direct contact about a data-sharing agreement.

name: ARAM – Association for Research and Archiving of Armenian Memory
name_local: Association pour la recherche et l'archivage de la mémoire arménienne
count_note: WordPress REST X-WP-Total, 2026-11-02: numerisation-presse 1,293 (digitized press batches, each a month or quarter of one title), livre 974, document 281, musique 195, portrait-expo-99 99, affiche-expo-1997 64, iconographie 21, presse 14 (newspaper titles), identite 5. Sum 2,932 records. Haratch is fully digitized: 22,214 issues, 1925–2009, about 600 GB, OCR searchable in Armenian/French, per the Haratch page.
terms_summary: The site has no terms, licence or legal page. The Haratch page says Arpik Missakian authorized its digitization and distribution on webaram.com, but gives no reuse licence. 'allowed' rests only on robots.txt (Yoast, no Disallow) and an open WP REST API, not on any legal grant. Ask ARAM before republishing files.
notes: WordPress 6.9 with WPML (FR/EN/ES/HY). Custom post types are exposed via /wp-json/wp/v2/{livre,presse,numerisation-presse,document,iconographie,identite,musique,...}, and Yoast sitemaps list every type. Each Haratch month has an online reader and a PDF download. Records hold little structured metadata (title, date, link), so parse the title strings ('TITLE – Armenian title – year – period').

name: Biblissima+ (portal, IIIF Collections of Manuscripts and Rare Books, data.biblissima.fr)
count_note: IIIF Collections search 2026-11-02: 'arménien' = 217 results (BnF/Gallica 183, MAF/ARCA 32, BSB 1, Blois 1; language facet Armenian 173). 'armenian' = 11 more (Bodleian, e-codices). Some overlap possible.
terms_summary: Biblissima authority data (data.biblissima.fr Wikibase) is under the French Licence Ouverte / Etalab 2.0, which allows commercial reuse with source attribution (not an SPDX id here, so marked custom). Aggregated records and images keep each holding library's terms (e.g. Gallica, ARCA CC BY-NC, Bodleian CC BY-NC).
notes: portail.biblissima.fr, data.biblissima.fr and its SPARQL endpoint are behind Anubis proof-of-work anti-bot (scripted access blocked 2026-11-02). iiif.biblissima.fr/collections is reachable; per-item manifest copies like iiif.biblissima.fr/collections/manifest/{hash}. Licence text read via search snippet of data.biblissima.fr home page.

name: BULAC (University Library of Languages and Civilizations)
name_local: Bibliothèque universitaire des langues et civilisations (BULAC)
count_note: BiNA digital library Omeka S API, 2026-11-02: item set 'Domaine arménien' (id 359095) = 984 items, all tagged language arm; subsets include 'Haratch' (949 items), 'Fonds de périodiques arméniens' (983), 'Midk ev Arvest' (34). fulltext_search 'arménien' = 991. Print holdings are larger (a 2023 interview cites over 6,600 works in the Armenian collection).
terms_summary: Unless stated otherwise, BiNA notices and texts are reusable under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab) with source citation, and images of public-domain documents are marked Public Domain Mark 1.0. Item-level dcterms:rights overrides this: in the Armenian set 675 items are CC BY-NC 4.0 (largely Haratch), 308 public domain, 1 rights reserved. The Omeka S REST API needs no key; no rate limit is published.
notes: Integrated 2026-11-02 with scripts/harvest_bina.py and the portal connector `bina_parquet`: 984 records, item-level rights kept (675 CC BY-NC 4.0, 308 Public Domain Mark, 1 in copyright shown without image). Harvest via Omeka S API with item_set_id=359095 (JSON-LD, totals in the Omeka-S-Total-Results header). The IIIF Server module is installed, so manifests are available per item. Haratch overlaps with ARAM's Haratch collection and archive.org HARATCH_YYYY-MM uploads; respect CC BY-NC for those.

name: FranceArchives
terms_summary: Datasets built from partner data are offered under the French Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab), which allows commercial reuse with source attribution. Digitised documents remain under each archive service's own reuse rules. Machine access is currently gated by a JS/cookie challenge, and no API key or published rate limit was found.
notes: Per a FranceArchives/Logilab presentation (SWIB 2023), an RDF dump modelled in RiC-O is published at https://data-dump.francearchives.gouv.fr/rdf/ (refreshed about every six months, roughly 400 million triples) and loaded into the SPARQL endpoint. FranceArchives is the French aggregator for the Archives Portal Europe. Search terms: arménien, Arménie, réfugiés arméniens, Office des réfugiés arméniens; overlaps with OFPRA and departmental archives (Bouches-du-Rhône).

name: Gallica (Bibliothèque nationale de France)
count_note: Figure 489 is the doc's Dec 2025 count (books 226, manuscripts 199, sound 40, press 15, maps 8, images 1); it could not be re-verified on 2026-11-02 because gallica.bnf.fr (including SRU) returned HTTP 403 to scripts and to WebFetch.
terms_summary: Descriptive metadata of Gallica documents is published under the French Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Non-commercial reuse of reproductions is free with the credit 'Source gallica.bnf.fr / BnF'; commercial reuse requires a licence and fee from the BnF (utilisation.commerciale@bnf.fr), partner-library items follow the partner's conditions, and in-copyright works are excluded. The IIIF and SRU APIs need no key and are open except for abusive use; no numeric rate limit is published, and plain scripts were blocked with 403 during the 2026-11-02 check.
notes: Query SRU with dc.language all "arm" plus gallica all "arménien"; IIIF manifests at https://gallica.bnf.fr/iiif/ark:/12148/{id}/manifest.json. data.bnf.fr (catalogue linked data, SPARQL) is also under Licence Ouverte and useful for Armenian authors. Gallica harvests partner libraries (e.g. Institut de France/Mazarine), so dedupe. Expect 403/anti-bot responses; use a low request rate and a descriptive User-Agent.

name: Bibliothèque Mazarine
count_note: Bibliothèques numériques de l'Institut de France search, 2026-11-02: 'arménien' = 3 results (all Bibliothèque Mazarine, printed books, 16th-17th c., incl. Rome editions with Granjon Armenian type); 'Armenian' = 0. Physical Armenian print holdings are not counted here.
terms_summary: Images and metadata of the Institut de France digital libraries are free for non-commercial reuse under CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 FR with a prescribed citation (author, title, date, holding library, shelfmark, permalink). Commercial reuse needs prior authorisation and a fee (bibnum@institutdefrance.fr). OAI-PMH and IIIF are offered for harvesting (the site says Gallica, Isidore and Europeana harvest it); no rate limit is published.
notes: OAI sets per library/type, e.g. oai:bibnum.institutdefrance.fr:sets:1:24224 (Mazarine: Imprimés). The OAI repository started 2024-10-10. Same records reach Gallica and Europeana, so dedupe. Physical Armenian holdings must be found in the Sudoc/Calames catalogues.

name: Musée Arménien de France (Fondation Nourhan Fringhian), Paris
count_note: 32 MAF manuscripts digitised by IRHT on ARCA with IIIF manifests: IArM v3.0 (32 rows) and Biblissima IIIF Collections facet 'Musée Arménien de France de Paris' = 32 (2026-11-02).
terms_summary: IRHT/ARCA IIIF manifests for MAF manuscripts declare CC BY-NC 3.0 with attribution to the Musée Arménien de France. Non-commercial reuse with credit; commercial use needs permission. Museum's own terms not found (site unreachable).
notes: Museum website timed out on 2026-11-02 (both www and bare domain). ARCA permalinks: https://arca.irht.cnrs.fr/ark:/63955/md03cz30sp89 (MAF126). Use IArM rows 'Musée Arménien de France - IRHT' as the item list.

name: OFPRA Archives – Armenian refugee files (Nansen-era protection records)
name_local: Office français de protection des réfugiés et apatrides (Ofpra) – portail des archives
terms_summary: The files hold personal data, so viewing nominative files needs an account that Mission Histoire staff validate, as the law requires for public archives under 100 years old with personal data. Ofpra's legal notice lets public information be reused free if it is not altered and the source and date are cited. Content with personal data or third-party rights cannot be reused without the consent of those concerned. The archive portal itself blocks automated clients with an Anubis challenge, and its robots.txt returns 403.
notes: Not harvestable: the bot check (Anubis) and login stop scraping, and personal data makes item-level aggregation legally sensitive. At most, a collection-level record should point to the portal. Background and access info: https://www.ofpra.gouv.fr/en/dossier/nos-fonds-darchives/archives-en-ligne. On-site reading room in Fontenay-sous-Bois by appointment.

name: British Library - Armenian manuscripts (Archives and Manuscripts Catalogue / Digitised Manuscripts)
count_note: Interim catalogue searcharchives.bl.uk, facet Language=Armenian, 2026-11-02: 5,198 records, of which 5,116 are EAP. Non-EAP: Oriental Manuscripts 52, Western Manuscripts 14, India Office 13, Music 3 (=82 records, not all are codices). Digitised platform facet: 32 'BL legacy Universal Viewer (unavailable)', 1 'BL legacy Digitised Manuscripts (unavailable)', 0 on the new 2024- platform.
terms_summary: New IIIF v3 manifests link rights to the BL page on reusing images of unpublished manuscripts. Secondary sources say many digitised manuscript images carry the Public Domain Mark, with a request to credit the BL; other items vary. No explicit catalogue metadata licence was found. The terms page could not be fetched here (blocked to tools).
notes: Interim Blacklight catalogue has JSON per record (append .json) and facets (language_ssim, collection_area_ssi, digitised content platform). robots.txt on bl.uk and searcharchives allows all. New manifests: https://bl.digirati.io/iiif/ark:/81055/... viewed via iiif.bl.uk/uv. Interim catalogue holds only pre-Oct-2023 records. BL also hosts EAP Armenian material (see gb.bl-eap).

name: British Library Endangered Archives Programme (EAP) - Armenian projects
count_note: BL interim catalogue, Language=Armenian AND Collection Area=Endangered Archives Programme: 5,116 records (2026-11-02); 4,227 in 'Preservation through digitisation of the endangered Armenian rare books...(phase 1)' (EAP180) and 477 in 'Armenian maps, periodicals and newspapers' (EAP613). EAP613/2 alone = 41,715 TIFF images.
terms_summary: EAP material is shared for research and non-commercial use. Where copyright applies, applicants grant a CC BY-NC licence, so the default is CC BY-NC but item terms vary. Commercial requests go back to the archive owner. Catalogue records note 'access is for research purposes only'; JPEG download depends on the custodian. The policy page was read via search snippets because eap.bl.uk blocks scripts.
notes: eap.bl.uk sits behind an AWS WAF JavaScript challenge (HTTP 202, empty body) for scripted clients; harvest metadata from searcharchives.bl.uk instead (JSON per record, e.g. /catalog/032-003382201.json = EAP613/2). Catalogue 'Digitised Content' links point to eap.bl.uk/collection/EAP613-2 etc. Overlap: EAP180/EAP613 content also exists at NLA/FSL Armenian digital libraries.

name: Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford (Digital Bodleian) - Armenian Manuscripts and Printed Books
count_note: Collection page (checked 2026-11-02): 140 Armenian mss held, images from 79 mss online. IIIF collection 'armenian' lists 94 manifests (70 unique shelfmarks). Online TEI catalogue repo has 127 entries in collections/. IArM lists 73.
terms_summary: Most images are CC BY-NC 4.0 (stated in each IIIF manifest's attribution). Non-commercial reuse needs shelfmark, institution, link and licence credit. Commercial use needs permission and fees. No metadata licence is stated on Digital Bodleian, and the TEI catalogue repo has no licence file.
notes: TEI P5 catalogue on GitHub: https://github.com/bodleian/armenian-mss (no licence); web catalogue https://armenian.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/ is behind Anubis proof-of-work anti-bot (not scriptable). Digital Bodleian robots.txt only blocks register/derivatives paths. Armenian palaeography site: armenianpalaeography.bodleian.ox.ac.uk. Overlaps IArM (73) and Biblissima IIIF Collections.

name: Gomidas Institute
terms_summary: The footer reads 'Copyright © 2026 The Gomidas Institute. All rights reserved.' No terms or licence page exists, and books are sold, not free. robots.txt allows all crawling, so 'allowed' covers crawling only, not reuse.
notes: Custom PHP CMS (credited to e-Works) with ID-based pages /books/show/{id} and /press/show/{id}. It returns HTTP 406 when the request has no browser Accept header. The blog is a separate WordPress site (blog.gomidas.org). Low priority: bibliographic metadata only.

name: Korneli Kekelidze Georgian National Centre of Manuscripts (Tbilisi)
name_local: კორნელი კეკელიძის სახელობის საქართველოს ხელნაწერთა ეროვნული ცენტრი
count_note: Oriental Manuscripts Fund page (manuscript.ge/aghmosavlur-xelnawerta-fondi, 2026-11-02): Armenian collection (ARM) has 311 manuscripts in Grabar and Ashkharabar. Earliest: Georgian-Armenian palimpsest A-491 (8th-9th c., Agathangelos); earliest dated Gospels Arm-18 (1307); Cilician hymnal Arm-173 (1329).
terms_summary: Site footer: 'All Rights Reserved © 2025 Manuscript'. No open licence or online Armenian manuscript images found. Reading-room access on site.
notes: New site in 'test mode' (Georgian, EN toggle). robots.txt allows all, but there is no catalogue or API for Armenian mss. EAP848 (Grishashvili Library-Museum, Tbilisi) is a separate EAP project. Armenian items also in other fonds (e.g. palimpsests).

name: Chester Beatty (Dublin) - Armenian manuscripts
count_note: IArM v3.0: 6 digitised Armenian items (Arm 551, 576.1, 576.2, 578, 614, 624). Full digitised count unknown: viewer search is robots-disallowed and behind Anubis.
terms_summary: Digital images of collection objects are CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise: reuse, remix and commercial use allowed with formal attribution to the Chester Beatty. Objects under other copyright need contact with photographic services. No explicit metadata licence.
notes: Goobi viewer at viewer.cbl.ie (Anubis proof-of-work on HTML pages). IIIF manifests at /viewer/api/v1/records/{PI}/manifest/ answered directly (license field is the placeholder 'iiif_license'). robots.txt disallows /viewer/search/, /viewer/oai, PDFs; Crawl-delay 10. Museum closed to visitors 15 Jun-Dec 2026.

name: Armenian Patriarchate of Jerusalem (St. James Monastery; manuscript library and Calouste Gulbenkian Library)
count_note: About 4,000 mss per Library of Congress collection notes (1949-50 microfilm survey). Online images: about 31 St. James mss via LoC microfilm scans (IArM rows) and 2 via Hebrew University. Printed Grand Catalogue: Bogharian, 11 vols (1966-1991).
terms_summary: No institutional online catalogue or terms found. The only online images are third-party: LoC microfilm scans, which LoC states are public domain, and Hebrew University pages.
notes: No official website could be confirmed: armenian-patriarchate.com is a parked domain and armenian-patriarchate.org carries spam; the URL points to a reference article. Use the LoC collection 'Manuscripts in the Libraries of the Greek and Armenian Patriarchates in Jerusalem' (IIIF manifests such as https://www.loc.gov/item/00271073938-jo/manifest.json). EAP823/EAP1142 cover St Saviour (Franciscan Custodia), not the Armenian Patriarchate.

name: GeoNames
count_note: GeoNames statistics page, 2026-11-02: Armenia (AM) = 10,517 features. Country dump AM.zip is 1,170,204 bytes, last modified 2026-11-02.
terms_summary: GeoNames data is free under a CC BY licence (credit GeoNames with a link), commercial use allowed, provided as-is. Daily dumps need no account; the web services need a registered 'username' and allow 10,000 credits per day and 1,000 per hour per application (the shared 'demo' account was exhausted during the 2026-11-02 check). Premium SLA services exist.
notes: Use AM.zip plus alternateNamesV2 for Armenian-script names; historical Armenian places outside Armenia need TR/IR/GE/AZ dumps. Link via Wikidata P1566.

name: Getty Vocabularies (AAT, TGN, ULAN)
count_note: vocab.getty.edu SPARQL, 2026-11-02: TGN places with gvp:broaderPartitiveExtended tgn:7006651 (Hayastan, nation) = 295; separate historical-region record tgn:7004538 'Armenia'.
terms_summary: AAT, TGN and ULAN are released by the J. Paul Getty Trust under ODC-By 1.0 with a suggested credit line. Full LOD downloads in N-Triples are refreshed monthly; XML and relational-table releases were discontinued (final archives drawn 2026-01-30). No key; no published rate limit.
notes: The tgn:7006657 id belongs to Belarus; Armenia (nation) is tgn:7006651. Use the prefix-declared /sparql endpoint (/sparql.json with unprefixed queries returned 500). CONA and IA are not available as LOD. /page/tgn/ links now redirect to the legacy getty.edu/vow display.

name: Index of Digitized Armenian Manuscripts (IArM)
count_note: 2,579 rows in index.tsv of Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.16355337 (v3.0, 22 Jul 2025); matches homepage counter; downloaded and counted 2026-11-02.
terms_summary: The compiled index dataset is published on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, so reuse incl. commercial is allowed with citation. The website footer says all rights reserved and the GitHub repo has no licence file; use the Zenodo release as the licensed copy. Images stay under each holding library's own terms.
notes: Integrated 2026-11-02 with scripts/harvest_iarm.py and the portal connector `iarm_parquet`: 2,579 records from the Zenodo v3.0 release; images stay with holding libraries. Live TSV also at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CVidalG/Index-of-Armenian-Manuscripts/refs/heads/master/index.tsv (site loads it via PapaParse). Columns: ID (Coulie sigla), Cat. Number, Location, Country, Town, Permalink, Digital Library, Support, Date, Pages, Size, Title, Note, Genre, IIIF Manifest. Top holders: HMML 1,780 (Bzommar 675, Istanbul Patriarchate ~778, Aleppo 144, Antelias 61), Gallica 182, Vatican 146, Bodleian 73, UCLA 63, Berlin 51. Use as master crosswalk for manuscript sources below. robots.txt allows all. Calfa also runs catalog.mechitar.org (Venice).

name: Internet Archive
count_note: archive.org advancedsearch, 2026-11-02: language:(arm OR armenian OR hye) = 7,467 (same via Scrape API); keyword 'armenian' = 35,030; 'armenian AND licenseurl:*publicdomain*' = 683.
terms_summary: Default terms limit use of collections to non-commercial, non-infringing or fair use and bar copying collections offsite without permission, but an item's declared licence (licenseurl/rights metadata) overrides the default. The Archive gives no guarantee of copyright status, so users carry the risk. Read APIs (advanced search, Scrape API, metadata API) need no key; no numeric rate limit was found.
notes: Use the Scrape API (https://archive.org/services/search/v1/scrape, cursor paging) for bulk ids, then /metadata/{id}. Language values are inconsistent (arm, armenian, hye, Armenian), so query all variants. Contains Haratch monthly scans (HARATCH_YYYY-MM), digitised Armenian books from many libraries, and audio. Overlaps with HathiTrust/Google scans and LoC. Per-item IIIF manifests exist via iiif.archive.org (root path returned 404; per-item paths not tested).

name: Monument Watch – Monitoring the Cultural Heritage of Artsakh
count_note: The homepage counters (read 2026-11-02 via fetch) show 2,785 'Historical Places' and 1,378 under 'Active Monitoring'. WP REST X-WP-Total, 2026-11-02: wpsl_stores (map and monument records) 1,162, alerts 780, facts_and_details 139, monitoring_watch 53, posts 377, media 5,651. The REST totals may mix the Polylang language versions.
terms_summary: Per the site footer, all published material belongs to the team and is protected by international copyright. Copying is not allowed without a link to the source section. Photos may not be used with the logo removed or cropped. There is no open licence or separate terms page, and robots.txt allows all.
notes: WordPress with Polylang (EN/HY/RU), WP Store Locator (map, wpsl/v1 and wpsl_stores CPT), CPT UI (alerts, monitoring_watch, facts_and_details), Wordfence and GiveWP. Bare curl gets 406: send a browser Accept header. Monument coordinates are likely in wpsl store meta (not checked). Content is politically sensitive, so keep provenance and attribution prominent.

name: Pleiades
terms_summary: Pleiades content (copyright Ancient World Mapping Center and ISAW) may be shared and remixed under CC BY 3.0. Use the daily dumps for bulk work: robots.txt sets Crawl-delay 3 and disallows several paths, and site search is behind a bot challenge.
notes: Latest JSON dump about 136 MB (Last-Modified 2026-11-02, HEAD verified). Also GitHub isawnyu/pleiades.datasets (pushed 2026-10-30; GitHub reports licence NOASSERTION, but the site states CC BY 3.0). Covers ancient and late-antique Armenia (Artaxata, Tigranocerta, provinces). Link via Wikidata P1584.

name: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage
count_note: ich.unesco.org/en/state/armenia-AM and data.unesco.org dataset ich001, 2026-11-02: 8 elements, all on the Representative List: 2008 Duduk and its music; 2010 Khachkars (cross-stone art); 2012 Daredevils of Sassoun / David of Sassoun epic; 2014 Lavash; 2017 Kochari; 2019 Armenian letter art; 2020 Pilgrimage to the St. Thaddeus Apostle Monastery (joint with Iran, countries IR+AM); 2023 Tradition of blacksmithing in Gyumri. No 2024 or 2025 inscriptions. Ongoing 2026 nominations: Tirgān/Vardavar water and rain tradition; winemaking in the Areni community.
terms_summary: The ich001 dataset on data.unesco.org (849 elements) is CC BY-SA 4.0; images and videos carry their own copyright/author fields. UNESCO's site terms (updated 2026-09-15) bar commercial use without a licence or authorisation, require citation (UNESCO, year, title, URL), prohibit bots, crawlers and bulk downloads (except ordinary search indexing), and require written permission for substantial or systematic database extraction and for AI training. ich.unesco.org robots.txt blocks AI crawlers.
notes: Use the data.unesco.org Opendatasoft API (where=search("Armenia") or filter countries contains 'AM'), not scraping ich.unesco.org. Fields: inscription_year, type_acronym (RL/USL/GSP), countries, concepts, whc_sites links, media. Duduk was first proclaimed a Masterpiece in 2005 and integrated into the Representative List in 2008.

name: UNESCO World Heritage Centre
count_note: data.unesco.org dataset whc001, 2026-11-02: Armenia has 3 properties: Monasteries of Haghpat and Sanahin (id 777, 1996, extended 2000); Cathedral and Churches of Echmiatsin and the Archaeological Site of Zvartnots (id 1011, 2000); Monastery of Geghard and the Upper Azat Valley (id 960, 2000). Armenian heritage abroad: Archaeological Site of Ani (Türkiye, id 1518, 2016); Armenian Monastic Ensembles of Iran (id 1262, 2008). Tentative List not checked on whc.unesco.org (403); press reports say about 8 entries after 2025 additions.
terms_summary: The World Heritage List dataset whc001 (1,273 properties, 6 UN languages, coordinates, components) is published on data.unesco.org under CC BY-SA 4.0; images carry author/copyright fields. whc.unesco.org itself returned 403 to scripts and WebFetch, and UNESCO terms (2026-09-15) prohibit bots, bulk downloads and systematic database extraction without written authorisation, so use the licensed dataset.
notes: Query whc001 with where=search("Armenia") or search("Armenian"): 9 hits, including non-Armenian sites mentioning Armenians (Bethlehem, Derbent, Lviv, Mtskheta), so filter manually. The legacy XML feed whc.unesco.org/en/list/xml/ returned 403. No Tentative List dataset is on data.unesco.org (whc002/whc003 do not exist).

name: VIAF: The Virtual International Authority File
terms_summary: VIAF data is published by OCLC under the Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By), with a recommended attribution statement (canonical VIAF URIs acceptable where the full statement is not feasible); the data page was last updated 2024-09-04. In January 2025 OCLC rebuilt the VIAF web and API interfaces: JSON search output changed and RDF now needs an Accept header, and reported errors raised governance concerns. Current dump availability and rate limits were not verifiable because the site blocked automated reads.
notes: Search with CQL, e.g. local.personalNames all "..."; prefer resolving ids from Wikidata (P214) instead of bulk VIAF calls. Client libraries (viapy, viafr) needed 2025 fixes, so test parsers against the current JSON.

name: Wikidata
count_note: WDQS, 2026-11-02: items with heritage designation (P1435) and country Armenia (P17=Q399) = 22,025; all items with P17=Q399 = 57,827.
terms_summary: Structured data is CC0 (Wikimedia Terms of Use apply to the service). WDQS limits: 60-second query timeout, 60 seconds of processing per minute per User-Agent+IP, 5 parallel queries per IP, 30 failed queries per minute; over-limit clients get 429 with Retry-After and may be banned. A descriptive User-Agent is required by the Wikimedia User-Agent policy.
notes: Integrated 2026-11-02 with scripts/harvest_wikidata.py and the portal connector `wikidata_parquet`; the MVP publication holds a sample of the first 120 items by QID (run with --limit to extend it to the full selection of 22,025). Scholarly articles were split into a separate graph; query-scholarly.wikidata.org/sparql answered on 2026-11-02, while heritage items stay on the main endpoint. Full JSON/RDF dumps at https://dumps.wikimedia.org/wikidatawiki/entities/ (verified). Good hub for cross-ids (Europeana, Commons categories, GeoNames, VIAF, Getty, Pleiades).

name: Wikimedia Commons
count_note: Commons API categoryinfo, 2026-11-02: sum of 'Images from Wiki Loves Monuments YYYY in Armenia' subcategories (2013-2026) = 158,323 files (largest: 2017 34,824; 2015 26,520; 2013 23,879). Category:Cultural heritage monuments in Armenia has 1,554 direct files; Category:Armenian manuscripts 243 direct files (subcategories not summed).
terms_summary: Every file carries its own free licence (CC BY-SA, CC BY, CC0, public domain), and Commons only accepts licences that allow commercial reuse; attribution/share-alike follow the file's licence. Text on file description pages is CC BY-SA 4.0, while Structured Data on Commons is CC0. API needs no key; follow the User-Agent policy and API etiquette (serial requests, maxlag).
notes: WLM Armenia 2015 and 2017 categories are labelled 'Armenia & Nagorno-Karabakh', so filter by monument id. Read licence/author per file via prop=imageinfo&iiprop=extmetadata. Pair with Wikidata heritage items (P1435, P17=Q399) and their Commons category (P373). Dumps of Commons wikitext and SDC exist on dumps.wikimedia.org.

name: Holy Savior (Vank) Cathedral museum and Nerses Shnorhali Library, New Julfa, Isfahan
name_local: Ամենափրկիչ վանք, Նոր Ջուղա / کلیسای وانک
count_note: 'More than 700 manuscripts' in the library per secondary sources (Wikipedia and others, 2026-11-02 search); not verified from an institutional source. No online catalogue.
terms_summary: vank.ir (Armenian Prelacy of Isfahan and Southern Iran) footer reserves all rights for the Prelacy. No digitised manuscripts or reuse terms found.
notes: vank.ir (fa, hy, en) has pages for the Nerses Shnorhali Library, a virtual tour and a music archive; Joomla site. Print catalogues of New Julfa mss exist (e.g. a catalogue series with Peria/Charmahal and private collections). Bodleian MS. Arm. d. 13 and Getty Ms. Ludwig II 7 are New Julfa-made mss held elsewhere.

name: Mekhitarist Congregation, San Lazzaro degli Armeni (Venice) - Library and Manuscript Catalogue
count_note: catalog.mechitar.org shows '1497 notices found' (2026-11-02). The printed 8-volume catalogue (1914-1998) has >2,500 records; Calfa says about a third of San Lazzaro mss are not yet in it. No digitised images online.
terms_summary: Raw catalogue data (OCR of the printed catalogue, by Calfa with the Mekhitarist Fathers) is CC BY-NC 4.0 per the repo README. Non-commercial reuse with attribution. No manuscript images are published, so no image terms apply.
notes: Catalogue PDFs are hosted by FSL NAS RA (serials.flib.sci.am/matenagitutyun). Congregation site mechitar.org now shows only a mobile-app landing page. catalog.mechitar.org robots.txt allows all. Calfa also OCR'd >6,000 pages of letters (1750-1900), not public as data. A 2013 Armenian government grant for digitising Venice mss has no visible online output.

name: Catholicosate of the Great House of Cilicia, Antelias (Cilicia Library and Manuscript Center; Cilicia Museum)
count_note: HMML news (Oct 2025): 239 manuscripts of the Catholicosate (digitised 2004-2005, project code ACC) are digitised, catalogued and in HMML Reading Room. IArM v3.0 (Jul 2025) listed only 61.
terms_summary: Online access is only via HMML Reading Room: catalogue metadata is CC BY 4.0, but images need a free vHMML login. Users may not copy or redistribute partner images without HMML authorisation. The Catholicosate keeps image rights.
notes: Official site returned HTTP 403 to scripted requests (bot protection); content not checked. The Cilicia Library is revising its Antelias and Aleppo catalogues (Armenian Prelacy news, Aug 2025). The Aleppo diocese mss (IArM: 144 via HMML) are a separate HMML repository. No separate online museum database found.

name: Haigazian University – Armenian Diaspora Research Center (ADRC)
count_note: DSpace 7 repository haigrepository.haigazian.edu.lb, discover API, 2026-11-02: Haigazian Armenological Review community 1,204 items plus ADRC community 49 = 1,253. Also HU Press 26 and Conference Proceedings 47. Whole repository 1,536 items, of which 910 match 'armenian'.
terms_summary: No licence was found. Repository records have no dc.rights field, and the university site could not be loaded. robots.txt blocks only /search, admin and submit paths, and OAI-PMH is public. Ask Haigazian before reusing PDFs.
notes: The main site returned 403/504 (Cloudflare) on 2026-11-02, while the repository was reachable. DSpace 7: REST at /server/api, OAI formats oai_dc, qdc, mods, mets, marc, rdf, didl, ore, xoai, dim, etdms, uketd_dc. Metadata is thin (author, date, title, URI, DOI) and some abstracts hold template placeholders. HAR volume PDFs are large (vol. 1 about 110 MB).

name: Bibliothèque Orientale, Université Saint-Joseph (Beirut)
name_local: Bibliothèque Orientale - Université Saint-Joseph de Beyrouth
count_note: IArM v3.0: 7 Armenian mss of USJ Bibliothèque orientale in HMML Reading Room. HMML's 2,929 figure (May 2024) is the total catalogued for the whole library, all languages, mostly Arabic Christian.
terms_summary: Access is via HMML Reading Room: catalogue metadata CC BY 4.0, images need login, and redistribution of images needs HMML authorisation. No USJ-specific reuse terms found.
notes: HMML repository page: hmml.org/collections/repositories/lebanon/université-saint-joseph--bibliothèque-orientale/ (in progress). Same HMML access blockers as us.hmml. Doc URL www.usj.edu.lb/bibliotheque/ not checked; USJ homepage reachable.

name: Foundation for Culture and Heritage of Polish Armenians
name_local: Fundacja Kultury i Dziedzictwa Ormian Polskich
count_note: The count is wiki.ormianie.pl articles (biographies of Polish Armenians): 1,826 articles and 2,612 images per the MediaWiki siteinfo API, 2026-11-02. The Virtual Archive (archiwum.ormianie.pl) publishes no totals. It has sections for metrical-book search, cemeteries, manuscripts and unindexed metrical books, old prints, newspapers and periodicals, books and articles, photos, paintings and liturgical objects. The foundation's fonds are also listed on szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl (JS-rendered, not counted).
terms_summary: The wiki (Wiki.Ormianie) declares CC BY-SA 3.0, so reuse, including commercial, is fine with attribution and share-alike. The Virtual Archive shows only '© Fundacja Kultury i Dziedzictwa Ormian Polskich 2023' with no licence, so treat its scans as all rights reserved. The licence code and commercial value given here apply to the wiki only.
notes: The ecosystem under ormianie.pl: dziedzictwo (foundation), archiwum (Virtual Archive of Polish Armenians, a PHP app with search pages ksiegi.php and archiwuma.php), wiki (MediaWiki 1.24.1, open api.php), skarbnica (museum exhibition, Warsaw, Świętojerska 12) and ordynariat (Armenian Catholic ordinariate). The archive is also on szukajwarchiwach.gov.pl and the Centrum Archiwistyki Społecznej database (cas.org.pl). Digitization was funded by MKiDN 'Zasoby cyfrowe' and MSWiA. Metrical books carry genealogical personal data.

name: Polona
count_note: Polona search API (POST /api/search-service/search/simple), 2026-11-02: 'ormiańsk*' = 265; 'Ormianie' = 229; 'Armenia' = 243; 'ormiański' = 112. A combined OR query returned 5,679 and looked unreliable, so it is not used.
terms_summary: The National Library of Poland says most Polona collections are public domain and free to download and use; each record carries a rights field (e.g. 'Domena Publiczna', which allows copying, modification and commercial use while respecting authors' moral rights). The JSON search API is the site's internal, undocumented backend; no published API terms, key or rate limit were found, and the main user terms ('Regulamin usługi') are linked from the site footer.
notes: Records expose language (e.g. 'ormiański'), metatype, sourceMeta (holding library, e.g. Biblioteka Jagiellońska, Patrimonium project) and rights. For Lviv Armenian community material, combine 'ormiańsk*' with 'Lwów'. Treat the internal API as unstable; throttle and identify the client. Polona content also reaches Europeana partly via Polish aggregators.

name: Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation – Armenian Communities Department
terms_summary: Site content is IP-protected and for personal use only, with no commercial use. Non-commercial reuse must clearly cite the source with a link, mark changes and make no derivatives. Archive images, video and documents may not be reproduced without written authorization, which may carry fees. Bots are not addressed, though robots.txt allows crawling.
notes: WordPress multisite under gulbenkian.pt with Yoast sitemaps per sub-site (EN and HY pages). Useful as a cross-reference: grant lists could seed provenance or 'funded-by' links in the registry. Not a harvest target.

name: Armenian Museum of Moscow and Culture of Nations
name_local: Армянский музей Москвы и культуры наций
terms_summary: Site terms of ANO 'Armkult' (Center of Armenian Culture and Culture of Nations) cover viewing and posting content; they grant no reuse licence and forbid using third-party IP without the rightsholder's consent. Footer carries a copyright notice of the museum.
notes: robots.txt blocks AI/ML crawlers by name (ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai, GPTBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, etc.) and disallows ?format=json and /api/. Not part of the Museum Fund, so absent from Goskatalog. Useful only as a link/reference source for Russian-language articles; do not harvest.

name: CyberLeninka
terms_summary: User agreement v. 24.11.2025 (operator OOO 'Iteos'): articles are provided free under Creative Commons or other open licences chosen by rightsholders, and services are for personal non-commercial use. It forbids commercial use of works, site elements or the database, and forbids bots, crawlers and scripts collecting information or metadata without prior written consent.
notes: OAI-PMH endpoint not confirmed (no Wayback captures of cyberleninka.ru/oai). Older reports say CyberLeninka feeds BASE, OpenAIRE, WorldCat via OAI-PMH, so harvesting its records through BASE/OpenAIRE (under their terms) may be the compliant route. robots.txt disallows /search, /api/, PDFs (except Googlebot).

name: Electronic Library of Historical Documents (EBID), Russian Historical Society
terms_summary: No terms of use found on the archived pages. The project aims to give open access to historical documents published in Russia since 1991, with indexes by author, archive/fund, date, names, places and topics.
notes: Unreachable from abroad; read via Wayback (platform: InfoRost, version 9.0.39). No API found. Low priority.

name: eLIBRARY.RU Scientific Electronic Library
terms_summary: User agreement (agreement.asp) could not be retrieved: the archived URL redirects to a session page. robots.txt (Wayback 2026) disallows most dynamic pages (author, org, citation, item lists, querybox). Full texts depend on subscriptions or open-access journals.
notes: Unreachable from abroad. Institutional access is IP-controlled per library contracts. No public API. Low priority: overlaps with CyberLeninka for open-access Russian journals.

name: Russian Museum of Ethnography
count_note: 2,242 Armenia-related REM records already in this repository's Goskatalog extraction. Online collection (collection.ethnomuseum.ru, KAMIS-based) shows 92,210 objects, 294 expeditions, 214 collectors (2026-11-02); Armenian search timed out.
terms_summary: Site content including images and texts may be used for personal non-commercial, educational and media purposes, with a mandatory link when quoting. Quality images and publication rights for images, texts or museum branding require prior written permission from the museum.
notes: collection.ethnomuseum.ru robots.txt disallows /api/ (the JSON backend), HTML pages allowed; sitemaps exist (sitemap.xml, sitemap1.xml, sitemap2.xml). Metadata overlap with Goskatalog is expected to be high; use the online collection only to enrich with images/links.

name: State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation
name_local: Государственный каталог Музейного фонда Российской Федерации
count_note: This repository's extraction from the full Goskatalog open-data Parquet export (31,741,256 records, 2.86 GB): 58,291 Armenia-related records included plus 86,714 in review. Wikipedia cites 4,761,949 items / 3,736 museums (Nov 2024), which conflicts with the dump size; treat Wikipedia figure as unreliable.
terms_summary: Dataset passport (Wayback capture 2025-03-13) applies the Russian federal 'Standard terms of use of open data' (2016): free reuse for commercial and non-commercial purposes without a contract, provided the source is cited, use is lawful and data are not distorted. The same passport states images are published for information only and remain museum property, so images are excluded from the open-data terms.
notes: goskatalog.ru and opendata.mkrf.ru reset connections from outside Russia (also via WebFetch); current availability of the dump could not be verified (Wayback shows a 404 on one item URL 2025-04-29). The Ministry described 2021 mass copying of the portal as 'hacker attacks' and blocked it, so use the bulk dump, not portal scraping. Hermitage (2,104), Russian Museum of Ethnography (2,242) and State Historical Museum (4,173) Armenian records are already inside this repository's Goskatalog extraction; Armenian Museum of Moscow is NOT a Museum Fund holder. Per-record image rights should be treated as all rights reserved by the holding museum; store links, not image copies.

name: State Hermitage Museum
count_note: 2,104 Armenia-related Hermitage records already found in this repository's Goskatalog extraction (2026). Own collection site not queried (unreachable).
terms_summary: All site content (information, images, other materials) is Hermitage property protected by copyright unless marked otherwise. It is intended for personal use only; any reproduction, distribution or publication needs Hermitage permission.
notes: hermitagemuseum.org and collections.hermitage.ru time out from abroad; policy read from Wayback capture 2024-09-17 (footer 1998-2024). Wayback has collections.hermitage.ru captures from 2024, so a newer collection portal exists. Use Goskatalog records and link out; do not copy images.

name: Institute of Oriental Manuscripts, Russian Academy of Sciences (IOM RAS), St Petersburg
terms_summary: Terms could not be checked: site unreachable. No IIIF or open-licence publication of Armenian mss found in search results.
notes: Site may be geo-restricted or down. Retry later from another network. Printed catalogues and Manuscripta Orientalia/Pis'mennye pamyatniki articles are the likely count sources. The National Library of Russia holds a further 111 Armenian mss (per the same article) - a separate source.

name: National Electronic Library (NEB)
terms_summary: NEB is a federal state information system operated by the Russian State Library. Users may use objects for personal, informational, scientific, educational and cultural purposes within Russian copyright law; in-copyright items are available only under licences with rightsholders. The agreement explicitly bans circumventing technical protection and mass automated downloading of NEB objects.
notes: rusneb.ru times out from abroad; terms read from Wayback capture 2026-04-24. Registration is optional for open items but needed for some functions; in-copyright items open only in authorised reading rooms. No public API or OAI-PMH documentation found. Aggregates RSL, NLR and Presidential Library digital copies, so expect duplicates with ru.rsl, ru.nlr and ru.prlib.

name: National Library of Russia
count_note: Scanned Armenian alphabetical card catalogue of the Dept. of National Literatures: >64,000 cards for Armenian-language books and serials from 1623 (nlr.ru/e-case3/sc2.php/arman, checked 2026-11-02). Separate catalogues: Armenian newspapers (>200 titles) and Armenian periodicals from 1845 (~1,100 cards). Armenian manuscripts: exact count not stated on the online exhibition; shelfmarks 'Арм. н.с.' go to at least 51; 44 codices came from Kamianets-Podilskyi in 1891.
terms_summary: All site content, including images and text, is for personal non-commercial use only; any full or partial reuse must link to nlr.ru. A separate policy page covers intellectual property placed on the site.
notes: robots.txt has 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /' (only Google, Bing, Yandex etc. are allowed), so generic harvesting is disallowed. The card catalogue is images only (no structured records); OCR or manual work would be needed. Primo catalogue (07NLR_VU1) and electronic library (nlr.ru/elibrary) are the discovery layers; no public OAI-PMH or open-data export found. Vivaldi (vivaldi.nlr.ru) is a DRM reader requiring a client app.

name: Presidential Library named after B. N. Yeltsin
terms_summary: No reuse terms page was found; the site footer states all rights are reserved by the Presidential Library. Only items free of copyright restrictions are open on the portal; others are viewable in the library and its regional e-reading rooms.
notes: prlib.ru times out from abroad; footer read from Wayback capture 2026-10-24. The library publishes 'metadata standards for cultural heritage' guidance but no public API/OAI-PMH was found. Low priority unless an Armenia-specific collection is confirmed.

name: Russian State Archive of Ancient Acts
terms_summary: No site terms of use found. Scanned inventories (описи) are published on the site; remote image access is offered for fond 350 (land-census and revision books) through the Rosarchiv document-access system; other documents are consulted in the reading room, and copies are ordered by e-mail as a paid service.
notes: rgada.info times out from abroad; read from Wayback capture 2026-10-17. Low priority for item-level integration; useful for finding-aid references (Lazarevs, Armenian merchants, 17th-18th c. Russian-Armenian relations).

name: Russian State Historical Archive
terms_summary: No site terms of use found. The online KAISA catalogue (fonds, inventories, files, name/place/subject indexes, flag for scanned sheets) is open; a personal account (login issued in person or remotely) is needed to order files, which are then consulted in the reading room. Copies are a paid service per the archive price list.
notes: fgurgia.ru times out from abroad; structure read from Wayback captures 2026. Site is built on InfoRost KAISA; no API/OAI found. Treat as a finding-aid source (fund/inventory-level records), not an item-level image source.

name: Russian State Military Historical Archive
terms_summary: Terms not found; site unreachable from abroad and no archived terms page located.
notes: Unreachable from abroad. Part of RGVIA WWI personnel records is reportedly exposed via the Ministry of Defence portal 'Памяти героев Великой войны' (gwar.mil.ru) - not verified in this pass. Low priority.

name: Russian State Library
terms_summary: Full access to the Electronic Library is available only in RSL reading rooms; outside the library, access to protected items follows Part IV of the Civil Code (copyright), so only public-domain items are open remotely. The site footer requires a direct link to rsl.ru when its materials are used.
notes: rsl.ru and search.rsl.ru time out from outside Russia; facts taken from Wayback. RSL is the operator of the NEB (rusneb.ru), so RSL digitized public-domain items also surface in NEB. No public API/OAI-PMH confirmed. Armenian-language items would need to be counted through search.rsl.ru language facets from inside Russia.

name: Runivers
terms_summary: ANO 'Runivers' claims rights in the portal content and its selection. Materials may be used only for personal non-commercial purposes; modification, republication, copying for third parties and derivative works are forbidden, and commercial use needs prior consent. Quotes require naming the portal with a hyperlink at the start.
notes: Active in Nov 2026 (Bitrix site). robots.txt disallows all URLs with query strings. Has a small 'datasets' section (Erlikhman countries-and-rulers table) but no API. Low priority.

name: Hrant Dink Foundation – Turkey Cultural Heritage Map
name_local: Hrant Dink Vakfı – Türkiye Kültür Varlıkları Haritası
count_note: GeoJSON from POST /a/mapPois (empty query), 2026-11-02: 9,727 points in total. By community: Armenian (Ermeni) 4,485, Greek (Rum) 4,225, Syriac 683, Jewish 314, other 20. Armenian by type: 2,413 churches, 1,325 schools, 434 monasteries, 177 cemeteries, 74 chapels, 48 orphanages, 9 hospitals, 4 fountains, 1 other.
terms_summary: Neither the map nor hrantdink.org shows a terms of use, copyright notice or data licence (only a privacy policy on the main site). The Foundation's printed reports carry '© Hrant Dink Vakfı Yayınları'. The project was funded by the EU and the Foundation. Ask the Foundation before bulk reuse.
notes: Data loads via JS (Leaflet). The undocumented internal endpoints are: POST /a/mapPois (form fields query, type), which returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection (id, poi_name, ethnicity_name, building_type_name, image, icon, lon/lat); GET /a/getPoisFilters, which returns filter vocabularies (cities, ethnicity, denomination, building type); and /a/exportPois (Excel export button). Behind Cloudflare, with ACAO '*'. There is no robots.txt (unknown paths fall back to the app shell). Detail-page URLs were not resolved. Expect Turkish place names and types, and map ethnicity 'Ermeni' to Armenian.

name: SALT Research
terms_summary: Digitized visual materials are provided for individual research under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: credit the creator or licensor as the record states, no commercial use, no derivatives. Commercial use, and documents viewable only on Salt's on-site WiFi, need a request to salt.research@saltonline.org. The DSpace host's robots.txt sets Content-Signal 'ai-train=no, use=reference' as a reservation of rights under EU DSM Article 4.
notes: Two platforms: an Ex Libris Primo VE discovery layer (vid 90GARANTI_INST:90SALT_VU1; robots disallows search, Crawl-delay 10) and a DSpace repository (archives.saltresearch.org/handle/123456789/...) behind a Cloudflare challenge. DSpace OAI-PMH (/oai/request) could not be checked because of the block. SALT is a Flickr Commons partner, so the Flickr API may be a cleaner route for its photo subset. A formal data request is advisable.

name: Armenian National Institute
count_note: Memorials database page (2026-11-02): 300+ Armenian Genocide memorials in 45 countries. Separate sample-document and photo galleries have no stated totals.
terms_summary: ANI claims copyright in its site content and compilation. Personal use (view, download, print) needs no permission. Copying material onto other websites is prohibited. Any publication, including digital, needs a written request and an ANI authorization letter that specifies the acknowledgment; links are allowed only from non-profit educational sites.
notes: Static HTML site (Armenian, Spanish, Turkish and Arabic subdomains). robots.txt blocks only specific bots. Source documents (US, German and British archival reports) may be public domain at origin, but ANI's transcriptions and images fall under its notice. Memorials database built with Rockefeller Foundation funding; good for monuments geodata after permission. No API.

name: Armenian Museum of America
count_note: Collection page (checked 2026-11-02): over 25,000 artifacts (~5,000 coins, 3,000+ textiles, 180 inscribed rugs); less than 5% on display. Separately: Mesrob G. Boyajian Library 30,000+ titles; Sound Archive ~3,000 discs of early Armenian recordings.
terms_summary: Terms of Service (Termageddon policy) say all site content is the museum's or third parties' property, all rights reserved. They expressly forbid robots, spiders, or other automated means to access, monitor, or copy site material. No image-licensing or open-access policy is published.
notes: Squarespace site with no searchable online collection database: objects are shown only on curated category pages. Library OPAC is Follett Destiny on a bare IP: http://207.180.166.147:8080 (no Z39.50/SRU checked). robots.txt only blocks /config, /search and /api, but the ToS ban on automated access governs. Integration needs a permission or data-sharing agreement.

name: Caucasus Heritage Watch
count_note: The public ArcGIS layer 'Heritage Site Conditions' (NKHeritageList_M14_viewlayer_14Jan2026/FeatureServer/2) returned 605 features (returnCountOnly) on 2026-11-02. The homepage reports 500+ sites monitored, 18 destroyed, 17 damaged and 40 threatened (last update Oct 2026). The WordPress heritage_site type has 31 impacted-site pages.
terms_summary: The site footer reads '© 2026 Caucasus Heritage Watch, Cornell University. All rights reserved.' The public ArcGIS dashboard, web map and feature layers have empty licenseInfo and accessInformation, so data reuse terms are unstated. Ask CHW (chw@cornell.edu) before redistributing; reports and maps should be cited.
notes: WordPress 7.1 with JetEngine. The heritage_site CPT is at /index.php?rest_route=/wp/v2/heritage_site.
