The live dashboard is ArcGIS Online item aab447a0d64f4eba84504e213953b748 (web map 3c75983928d04827b122ded28f967ab3). Feature layer fields: Site_No, Province_pre2020_ARM, Province_post2020_AZE, Type, Name, Begin_age, End_age, Current_Site_Status, Current_Monitoring_Status, Initial_Impact_Season, Initial_impact_mission_no. The query endpoint supports f=json/geojson. Monitoring reports (#9, Oct 2026) and StoryMaps are linked from the site. Related book: Heritage Forensics (Cornell UP).

name: Columbia Armenian Oral History Archive, 1968-1977 (Oral History Archives at Columbia, Rare Book & Manuscript Library)
count_note: A 2025 Archival Science article (doi 10.1007/s10502-025-09516-7, via search) gives 139 oral histories; a Columbia RBML blog post says '130+ interviews'. Interviews are in Armenian, English and Turkish. Count not checked in the finding aid itself, which sits behind a bot challenge.
terms_summary: Uses beyond fair use (publication, broadcast, display, derivatives) need a media permission licence. The Oral History Archives license only material whose copyright Columbia Trustees own; for other interviews, contact the narrator or estate. Scholarly use is fee-free; commercial audio was $175 per the page (via search). Item records carry US copyright or private-study notices, and some items need a Columbia login.
notes: findingaids.library.columbia.edu, dlc.library.columbia.edu and clio.columbia.edu all return an Anubis proof-of-work bot challenge to scripted clients; it was not bypassed. DLC robots.txt sets Crawl-delay 10 and exposes a sitemap: https://dlc.library.columbia.edu/sitemaps/sitemap.xml.gz. Item example: https://dlc.library.columbia.edu/catalog/cul:0k6djh9xsr. Ask Columbia for an EAD/MARC export or whitelisting.

name: Digital Public Library of America
terms_summary: DPLA dedicates all aggregated metadata to the public domain under CC0; DPLA's own site content (e.g. visual assets) is CC BY, and the underlying digital objects keep each contributing institution's rights statement (edmRights). The API needs a free 32-character key, which is emailed after an HTTP POST to https://api.dp.la/v2/api_key/{email}; keys can be revoked for abuse. No official rate limit could be confirmed because the developer policy pages blocked automated reading.
notes: Monthly full JSON dumps are publicly listable in the S3 bucket https://dpla-provider-export.s3.amazonaws.com/ (prefixes by year/month; latest seen 2026/10/; includes per-hub files and all.json.gz). Filtering the dump locally avoids the key requirement for bulk work. Heavy overlap with HathiTrust, Smithsonian, NYPL, LoC and Internet Archive content; dedupe by isShownAt/original record id.

name: Armenian Studies Program, California State University, Fresno
count_note: Internet Archive collection csufarmenianstudies (via California Revealed): 157 items (103 images, 54 texts), API count 2026-11-02. Flickr Commons photo count not checked (API key needed). The Index of Armenian Architecture has ~65 monument pages. Program library catalogue on LibraryWorld (size not verified).
terms_summary: Flickr Commons images are marked 'no known copyright restrictions'. On Internet Archive, 30 items carry the Public Domain Mark 1.0; others are copyrighted by donors (e.g., Richard A. Hagopian, the Chookasezian family) and online access does not permit further reproduction.
notes: Index of Armenian Architecture: static HTML pages by building type at /armenianstudies/resources/architecture/; no data download. The IAA miniatures page links to the Hamburg Index of Armenian Art. Flickr: http://www.flickr.com/photos/145517650@N04/albums. Library OPAC: https://opac.libraryworld.com/library/ASP. A George Injajikian papers finding aid PDF is on the site. No Fresno State CONTENTdm found (fresnostate.contentdm.oclc.org gives 403/notfound). Best harvest route: Internet Archive metadata API, plus the Flickr API with a key.

name: J. Paul Getty Museum - Armenian manuscripts
count_note: IArM v3.0 lists 4 Getty objects (e.g. collection objects 1351, 1358). Holdings include Zeyt'un Gospels canon-table leaves by T'oros Roslin (Ms. 59, 1256) and the Mesrop of Khizan Gospels (Ms. Ludwig II 7, Isfahan 1615). Getty SPARQL not queryable anonymously, so no exact count.
terms_summary: Getty API docs state collection data is CC0. Open Content images of public-domain works are free to download and reuse without restriction (CC0); check each object, since some images are not Open Content.
notes: Linked Art JSON-LD REST at data.getty.edu/museum/collection/object/{uuid}; activity stream works without auth (4.56M activities). The SPARQL endpoint (/museum/collection/sparql) returned 401 'Authorization token is wrong or missing' to anonymous GET/POST on 2026-11-02. IIIF Image API on media.getty.edu. Docs URL returned 404 to curl and TLS error to WebFetch; licence taken from Getty docs via search snippet. Zeyt'un leaves: ownership settled with the Catholicosate of Cilicia (2015), which donated them to the Getty.

name: Hairenik Association - Hairenik Digital Archives (Hairenik / Armenian Weekly)
terms_summary: Searching is open, but opening PDFs needs a paid subscription ($35/year individual; a $500/year multiuser licence was reported in 2020). The archive's disclaimer lets single images be reused if Hairenik Digital Archives is credited with a link. Reusing multiple images, or any commercial use, needs prior Hairenik Association approval.
notes: hairenik.org is a parked GoDaddy domain; the Association's site is hairenik.com, which sits behind Cloudflare and blocks curl. The archive is a WordPress site on hisystems.net; PDFs are delivered through Google Drive sharing to subscribers' Gmail accounts, with file prefixes AW/HW/HD. armenianweekly.com is also Cloudflare-protected (403 to curl), with metered article access. The Armenian Weekly ended print in June 2025. No API.

name: HathiTrust Digital Library
terms_summary: Under the Metadata Sharing and Use Policy, metadata HathiTrust owns is shared under CC0 and may be harvested, modified and reused via Hathifiles, the Bibliographic API, OAI feed and collection exports, provided as-is. Volume access follows per-item rights codes (pd, pdus, ic, cc-*), and pdus items are public domain only in the US. Web pages block plain scripts; computational access to full text goes through the HathiTrust Research Center.
notes: Hathifiles: tab-delimited full file on the 1st of each month plus daily updates (about 1 GB, 17M+ rows); filter lang='arm' and keep rights code and access fields. Bibliographic API supports lookup by OCLC/LCCN/ISBN/HTID. Overlaps with Internet Archive and Google Books scans, and HathiTrust is a DPLA hub.

name: Hill Museum & Manuscript Library (HMML) - vHMML / HMML Reading Room
count_note: IArM v3.0 rows with Digital Library=HMML: 1,780 (Lebanon 794 incl. Bzommar 675; Turkey 778 = Istanbul Patriarchate; Syria 146; Iraq 51). HMML says >760 Istanbul Patriarchate mss viewable and 239 Antelias mss (Oct 2025). Data Portal count not taken (Turnstile).
terms_summary: Reading Room and Museum metadata are CC BY 4.0. Viewing images needs a free account. Users agree not to copy or redistribute partner-library images without HMML authorisation; misuse can suspend the account. Only HMML-owned items are CC BY-NC 4.0.
notes: Data Portal exports JSON (curated or full Reading Room dataset) but is protected by Cloudflare Turnstile; do not automate, request the dataset from HMML (help@vhmml.org) instead. robots.txt disallows /image/, /image/manifest/folio and /user/acceptReadingRoomAgreement. Stable record URIs: https://w3id.org/vhmml/readingRoom/view/{id}. Largest single source of digitised Armenian mss (Bzommar, Istanbul, Antelias, Aleppo, Baghdad, Mosul, Lviv).

name: Library of Congress
terms_summary: No API key. Published limits: loc.gov JSON/YAML API 20 requests/min (1-hour block if exceeded), image/text services 150/min, lccn.loc.gov MARCXML 30/min (72-hour block); the legal page also asks automated programs to stay at or below 10 requests/min across all machines, honour robots.txt (which disallows /search and sets Crawl-Delay 5), and warns jobs over 24 hours may be terminated. Library-created US Government works are public domain in the US and offered under CC0 internationally; collection items carry per-item rights advisories, and the Library generally does not own the rights, so users must check copyright status themselves.
notes: Use facet fa=language:armenian and the Armenian Rarities collection (https://www.loc.gov/collections/armenian-rarities/). Paginate with c=1000 and stay below the 100,000-item deep-paging limit; fetch item JSON with &fo=json&at=item,resources. Bulk MARC catalog records are offered for free download (loc.gov/cds/products/marcDist.php). Script access is currently challenged by Cloudflare, so plan a polite, rate-limited client or use bulk MARC. Overlaps: HathiTrust and Internet Archive (LoC-scanned books), DPLA (LoC is a DPLA hub).

name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
count_note: Met Collection API v1.1 search, 2026-11-02: q='Armenia' = 235; q='armenian' = 213 (199 with images); q='Armenian' with artistOrCulture=true = 69; geoLocation=Armenia = 115. The union was not computed.
terms_summary: The Open Access dataset and API data are CC0, and high-resolution images of public-domain works (isPublicDomain=true) are CC0 for any use; in-copyright works have identifying data only. No key or registration; the docs ask clients to stay under 80 requests per second. API use is subject to the Met's terms and conditions.
notes: The old /public/collection/v1/search was retired on 2026-10-01 (HTTP 410). Its replacement is /public/collection/v1.1/search (Elastic-backed, offset/limit paging, limit up to 500, offset+limit up to 10,000, same filters as v1). Enumerate fully via /public/collection/v1/objects or the GitHub CSV metmuseum/openaccess (CC0, last pushed 2026-10-26). Filter CSV on Culture/Country containing Armenia/Armenian. Object records link to Wikidata and ULAN.

name: The Armenian Mirror-Spectator
count_note: Archives page (2026-11-02) lists 14,290 web articles, year filter 2008-2026. Past Issues has ~86 listing pages of print-edition PDFs, from June 13, 2009 to Oct 31, 2026. No online digitized run for 1932-2008 was found.
terms_summary: The site claims copyright with all rights reserved; no detailed terms of use or reuse licence was found. Recent PDF issues are linked for direct download without a stated paywall.
notes: WordPress; PDFs at /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/Armenian-Mirror-Spectator-<date>.pdf. The site returns 403 to curl (bot protection), though WebFetch worked; respect it. Owned by Baikar Association (Watertown, MA). The paper descends from the Armenian Mirror (1932) and merged with the Spectator in 1939. Pre-2009 back issues need contact with the publisher or libraries holding microfilm.

name: NAASR Edward and Helen Mardigian Library (National Association for Armenian Studies and Research)
count_note: Library page (2026-11-02): over 39,000 books, pamphlets, periodicals and documents, mainly Armenian and English, back to the 1600s. Includes the 3,000+ title Bournoutian collection and personal papers (Derounian, Guerguerian, Vertanes, etc.).
terms_summary: No library-specific terms of use or reuse policy was found. The site footer gives only a NAASR copyright notice. The robots.txt is a Shopify storefront file that allows crawling.
notes: Catalogue is Follett Destiny (naasr.follettdestiny.com portal). Search results report WorldCat participation from 2025 and records in the National Library of Armenia's catalogue, a possible easier harvest route; not verified. Digitized yearbooks are listed in a Dropbox .docx; the Derounian finding aid is a Dropbox PDF. 'Library Treasures' blog posts. The site is a Shopify storefront whose robots.txt carries shopping-agent text, which was ignored. NAASR holds a perpetual USC Shoah Foundation VHA subscription for on-site use.

name: NYPL Digital Collections
terms_summary: Repo API access needs a token obtained by sign-up and is limited to 10,000 requests per day per token; the API page now states the API is deprecated and no longer available from 2026-08-01, with no public replacement planned (the endpoint still answered 401 'Access denied' on 2026-11-02). Item-level rights statements apply (No Known U.S. Copyright Restrictions, CC0, NYPL-held copyright, Undetermined), and publicDomainOnly=true filters to cleared items. No metadata licence is stated for the API.
notes: API is end-of-life, so do not build a pipeline on it. A CC0 snapshot of public-domain items (January 2016 release) is on GitHub NYPL-publicdomain/data-and-utilities (archived); filter it for Armenian subjects. Otherwise manual or browser-based discovery only.

name: OPenn (University of Pennsylvania Libraries), incl. Free Library of Philadelphia and Walters mirror
count_note: Only clear Armenian item found on OPenn: UPenn LJS 443 (calendar texts, Armenia, after 1416), repo 0001. FLP Lewis T451 (Armenian fragment) is on FLP's own site, not in OPenn 0023 contents. Plus Walters Armenian mss in OPenn mirror _0020 (see us.walters). Checked via *_contents.csv and Digital Scriptorium, 2026-11-02.
terms_summary: Licences are per repository. Penn LJS (0001) and Penn Libraries (0002): images Public Domain Mark, metadata CC BY 4.0. Free Library (0023): images PDM, metadata CC0. Walters mirror: CC0. All OPenn content is public domain or Free Cultural Works CC licences.
notes: Per-repo contents CSVs at /Data/{repo}_contents.csv (title only, no language column); TEI msDesc per item. robots.txt only disallows *.tif/*.tiff for crawlers. Server very slow (20-40 s per request) on 2026-11-02. Digital Scriptorium (search.digital-scriptorium.org, Language=Armenian) lists 43 US Armenian items, useful for Penn/FLP/Chicago crosswalk.

name: Project SAVE Armenian Photograph Archives (Project Save Photograph Archive)
count_note: Homepage (2026-11-02): 150,000+ photographs from the 1860s to the present. The licensing page says 19% of the physical collection is digitized; online record count unknown because the catalogue blocks scripted access. Digital Commonwealth holds 224 Project SAVE items (API count 2026-11-02).
terms_summary: Images are licensed for a fee, per project, only for the uses on the invoice. Licensees may not crop or alter images without approval and must credit Project SAVE and the collection. The terms forbid using images, captions, keywords or other metadata for machine learning/AI or person-identification technology.
notes: The homepage is Squarespace; its robots.txt disallows / for AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot, etc.). The catalogue is a hosted collections portal (fields Objects/Photos/Archives/Library/People/Search Terms, likely PastPerfect-style; vendor unverified). Its robots.txt disallows /api/, and it returned HTTP 403 to curl and WebFetch. Easiest harvestable subset: Digital Commonwealth (BPL) collection commonwealth:cr56n7883 via its JSON API/OAI (rights 'not evaluated', licence 'contact host'). A selection also appears in USC Shoah Foundation IWitness. Needs a partnership.

name: Rockefeller Archive Center - Near East Foundation records (Near East Relief)
terms_summary: RAC dedicates its archival description and library records (DIMES HTML and JSON) to the public domain under CC0; attribution is encouraged, not required. CC0 does not cover linked images or digital objects, whose rights vary by item and donor. Publication may need RAC and donor permission.
notes: DIMES catalogue: https://dimes.rockarch.org (SPA; robots allows all). The JSON API host api.rockarch.org returned 403 to curl. Bulk EAD and METS are on GitHub, updated regularly. IIIF/Mirador viewer is reported for digitized objects; not verified. No NEF collection hit was confirmed in DIMES via search. Near East Relief Historical Society Digital Museum: https://neareastrelief.org/ (neareastmuseum.com redirects there), assets on NetX (https://neareast.netx.net/portals/digital-museum/); a free account opens the full archive. Its rights policy (https://neareastrelief.org/rights-use-policy/) uses item-level rights, aims at non-commercial research/education, and grants no permissions itself.

name: Smithsonian Open Access
count_note: Open Access API (DEMO_KEY), 2026-11-02: q='armenian' = 408 records (89 with images). By unit: Smithsonian Libraries 241, NMAH 71, Center for Folklife and Cultural Heritage 45, NMNH Anthropology 17, SAAM 7, NMNH Mineral Sciences 6, NMAAHC 4, National Museum of Asian Art (former Freer|Sackler) 1.
terms_summary: Open Access metadata is CC0, and media flagged CC0 (metadata_usage.access = CC0) can be reused for any purpose; records with copyright limits have CC0 metadata but no media. API keys come from api.data.gov (DEMO_KEY for testing; a 2026-11-02 check saw x-ratelimit-limit 10 on DEMO_KEY; registered keys commonly get 1,000 requests/hour per api.data.gov defaults, not confirmed on an official page). Bulk data is mirrored without rate limits.
notes: Bulk: public S3 bucket smithsonian-open-access (us-west-2; prefixes metadata/, media/, images/, 3d/), verified listable, and the GitHub repo Smithsonian/OpenAccess (weekly JSON). Filter by unitCode and content.indexedStructured. Most hits are Smithsonian Libraries books and Folklife recordings.

name: Richard G. Hovannisian Armenian Genocide Oral History Collection (formerly UCLA Armenian Genocide Oral History Project)
count_note: 1,000+ audio interviews recorded 1972-2000 by Hovannisian and his UCLA students, mostly in California. Per the SFI obituary (2023-07-13), 636 are available in the USC Shoah Foundation VHA. Language is mostly Armenian, up to ~20% English, a few Turkish/Spanish.
terms_summary: The collection is now served only through the USC Shoah Foundation VHA, so VHA terms apply: personal, educational, non-commercial use only. Automated scraping and downloading are banned, and copies or licences go through SFIAccess.
notes: Duplicate of us.usc-shoah-vha content: model it as a sub-collection and dedupe. In VHA Online, filter by the collection checkbox 'Richard G. Hovannisian Armenian Genocide Oral History Collection'. Collection info: https://sfi.usc.edu/content/hovannisian-collection-text.

name: USC Dornsife Institute of Armenian Studies
count_note: Approximate. A July 2025 Institute news item says the Armen Aroyan Collection has ~400 videotapes (trips 1988-2016, ~100 tours, ~1,470 participants), and 'nearly half' is on USC Digital Library. No item counts exist for the ephemera or Armenian Radio Hour projects.
terms_summary: USC Digital Library gives copyright and use information per item in its Rights fields. Reuse beyond fair use needs the copyright owner's written permission, and commercial use of copyrighted works needs a request. USC Libraries expects users to cite the collection and credit USC Libraries; publication may need a fee-based license.
notes: Aroyan collection page: https://digitallibrary.usc.edu/CS.aspx?VP3=SearchResult&VBID=2A3BXZLVXCTWQ&PN=1&WS=PackagePres. The page is a JS-heavy Orange Logic UI. No public OAI-PMH or IIIF was found; robots.txt sets Crawl-delay 30 and disallows /Share/ and thumbnail utilities. A sitemap index is exposed (gzip). Ask USC Libraries (specol@usc.edu) or armenian@usc.edu for a metadata export.

name: USC Shoah Foundation Visual History Archive
count_note: Two Armenian collections, summed. Armenian Film Foundation (J. Michael Hagopian): 333 audio-visual interviews with 380+ people (sfi.usc.edu/content/armenian-genocide). Richard G. Hovannisian collection: 636 interviews available (SFI obituary, July 2023) out of 1,000+. Whole VHA: 60,394 testimonies.
terms_summary: VHA website terms (revised 2017-11-01) grant a limited, revocable licence for personal, educational, non-commercial use only. They ban automated scripts, scraping, framing, and systematic downloading or printing. Unauthorized copying, downloading or recording of interviews is prohibited; reuse licences go through SFIAccess (sfiaccess.usc.edu).
notes: Angular SPA with an internal, non-public API (vha.usc.edu/services/api/...). The terms text loads from vha.usc.edu/assets/html/termsofuse.html. VHA Online (free registration) shows metadata for all testimonies but full video for only ~4,430. Full access is at ~204 subscribing institutions, e.g. NAASR (perpetual subscription) and AGMI Yerevan. Ingest only via a negotiated agreement; record collection-level metadata only.

name: Walters Art Museum - Armenian manuscripts (Digital Walters)
count_note: IArM v3.0: 11 Walters Armenian mss (W.537-W.547). OPenn mirror of Digital Walters (2018 snapshot) has W537, W538, W539, W543 in that range (checked 2026-11-02).
terms_summary: Since 6 Feb 2013 all Walters manuscript images and descriptions are CC0 (also GFDL); the earlier non-commercial restriction was dropped. No permission is needed. Citation and a courtesy copy to the curator are requested but not required.
notes: thedigitalwalters.org failed TLS (HTTP 525) and art.thewalters.org / thewalters.org returned 403 to scripted requests on 2026-11-02. Use the OPenn mirror (_0020) with TEI msDesc + images per W-number. Walters is also listed among vHMML CC partners. IArM permalinks point to thedigitalwalters.org/Data/WaltersManuscripts/html/W537 etc.

name: Krikor and Clara Zohrab Information Center
count_note: Online catalogue covers 15,000+ volumes (catalogue launch notice); other Center posts claim 20,000+ to 50,000+ items in total. Special collections include the Vava Sarkis Khachaturian papers, Arshile Gorky material, maps/atlases, and hmayils.
terms_summary: No terms of use or reproduction policy was found on the Center's website. Digital copies are by request to the coordinator, and holdings do not circulate.
notes: Part of the Eastern Diocese of the Armenian Church of America, at St. Vartan Cathedral, NYC. The catalogue runs on Bibliovation (Koha-based); its robots.txt disallows all crawling (User-agent: * Disallow: /), and a Koha OAI path was not found. The old catalogue domain zohrabcentercatalog.com no longer resolves. WordPress site with a 'Digitized Books' post category. Ask for a MARC export.

name: Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana - DigiVatLib (Vat. arm., Borg. arm. and other fonds)
count_note: IArM v3.0: 146 BAV Armenian mss (Borg. 90, Vat. 48, Barb. 4, Chig. 2, Arch. 2), 137 with IIIF manifests. Fondo pages digi.vatlib.it/mss/Vat.arm and /mss/Borg.arm list 42 and 83 distinct shelfmarks (2026-11-02).
terms_summary: The DigiVatLib footer says text and images may not be reproduced in any form without BAV authorisation. Manifests carry 'Images Copyright Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana' and no licence. Publication or professional use needs a permission request and fees, with shelfmark credit 'by permission of BAV, all rights reserved'. Linking and viewing via IIIF is practical, but republishing images is not.
notes: IIIF v2 manifest pattern: https://digi.vatlib.it/iiif/MSS_{Fondo}.{n}/manifest.json (e.g. MSS_Borg.arm.1). robots.txt disallows /search, /*/search, /*/detail/*, /about, /news and sets Crawl-delay 10 (Bingbot 30); /iiif and /mss/ are not disallowed. Metadata reuse terms not stated.
